'''Slavik Vlado Jablan''' ({{langx|sr|Славик Владо Јаблан}}; 10{{nbsp}}June 1952 – 26{{nbsp}}February 2015) was a Serbian mathematician and crystallographer. Jablan is known for his contributions to [[Dichromatic symmetry|antisymmetry]], [[knot theory]], the theory of [[symmetry]] and [[Ornament (art)|ornament]], and [[ethnomathematics]].

== Career ==
Jablan was born on 10 June 1952 in [[Sarajevo]]. Jablan graduated in mathematics from the [[University of Belgrade]] (1977), where he also gained his M.A. degree (1981) and Ph.D. degree (1984) with the dissertation ''Theory of Simple and Multiple Antisymmetry in E2 and E2\{O}''. He was a [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright scholar]] in 2003/4. Jablan was a professor of geometry at the [[University of Niš]] until 1999; subsequently he was a researcher at the Mathematical Institute of the [[Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref name=obituary>Crowe, D., Darvas, G., Huylebrouck, D., Kappraff, J., Kauffman, L., Lambropoulou, S., Przytycki, J., Radović, L., Sazdanovic, R., De Spinadel, V.W., et al. (2015). ''In Memoriam: Slavik Jablan 1952–2015''. Symmetry, '''7''', 1261-1274. {{doi|10.3390/sym7031261|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref name=remembering>Kauffman, L.H., Lambropoulou, S. and Sazdanovic, R. eds. (2016). ''Remembering Slavik Jablan'', J. Knot Theory Ramif., '''25'''(9) {{doi|10.1142/S0218216516020028}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Radović |first1=Ljiljana |title=Slavik Jablan (1952-2015) |url=https://www.mi.sanu.ac.rs/novi_sajt/aboutus/history/distiguished_mathematicians/jablan.php |publisher=Mathematical Institute of the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts |access-date=11 August 2025}}</ref>

Jablan established the online journal ''VisMath'' in 2005 and was its editor from its inception until 2014. He joined the editorial board of the journal ''[[Symmetry (journal)|Symmetry]]'' in 2009 and was editor-in-chief from 2012 until 2015. After his death the journal printed a 14-page obituary.<ref name=obituary/> ''[[Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications]]'' printed a special issue in his memory in 2016.<ref name=remembering/>

== Works ==
Books published by Jablan:

* Theory of symmetry and ornament (1995)<ref>Jablan, S.V. (2002). ''[https://www.emis.de/monographs/jablan/index.html Theory of symmetry and ornament]'', Mathematical Institute: Belgrade {{ISBN| 86-80593-17-6}}</ref>
* Symmetry, ornament and modularity (2002)<ref>Jablan, S.V. (2002). ''Symmetry, ornament and modularity'', World Scientific: Singapore {{ISBN| 978-9-812-38080-7}}</ref>
* LinKnot: knot theory by computer (2007)<ref>Jablan, S.V. and Sazdanovic, R. (2007). ''LinKnot: knot theory by computer'', World Scientific: Singapore {{ISBN| 978-9-812-77223-7}}</ref>

Jablan published 65 academic papers. Selected papers available in English:

Antisymmetry and [[Polychromatic symmetry|coloured symmetry]]:
* Groups of conformal antisymmetry and complex antisymmetry In E2\{0} (1985)<ref>Jablan, S. (1985). ''Groups of conformal antisymmetry and complex antisymmetry In E2\{0}'', Z. Krist., '''173''', 129-138</ref>
* A new method of generating plane groups of simple and [[multiple antisymmetry]] (1986)<ref>Jablan, S.V. (1986). ''A new method of generating plane groups of simple and multiple antisymmetry'', Acta Cryst., A'''42''', 209-212</ref>
* Enantiomorphism of antisymmetric figures (1986)<ref>Jablan, S. (1986). ''Enantiomorphism of antisymmetric figures'', Sov. Phys. Cryst., '''31'''(5), 600-601</ref>
* Colored antisymmetry (1992)<ref>Jablan, S. (1992). ''[http://symmetry-us.com/Journals/3-1/jablan.pdf Colored antisymmetry]'', Symmetry Cult. & Sci., '''3'''(1), 38-39</ref>
* ''Farbgruppen'' and their place in the history of colored symmetry (2007)<ref>Jablan, S.V. (2007). Farbgruppen ''and their place in the history of colored symmetry'', Forma y Simetría: Arte y Ciencia, Congreso de Buenos Aires, 262-265</ref>

Knot theory:
* Nonplanar graphs derived from Gauss codes of virtual knots and links (2011)<ref>Jablan, S., Radović, L. and Sazdanović, R. (2011). ''Nonplanar graphs derived from Gauss codes of virtual knots and links'', J. Math. Chem., '''49''', 2250-2267 {{doi| 10.1007/s10910-011-9884-6}} [[OEIS]]:{{OEIS link|A145269}}</ref>
* Knots in art (2012)<ref>Jablan, S., Radović, L., Sazdanović, R. and Zeković, A. (2012). ''Knots in art'', Symmetry, '''4''', 302-328 {{doi| 10.3390/sym4020302|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* Delta diagrams (2016)<ref>Jablan, S., Kauffmann, L.H. and Lopes, P. (2016). ''Delta diagrams'', J. Knot Theory Ramif., '''25'''(9) {{doi| 10.1142/S021821651641008X}}</ref>

Ornament and ethnomathematics:
* Antisymmetry and modularity in ornamental art (2001)<ref>Radovic, L. and Jablan, S. (2001). ''[https://www.mi.sanu.ac.rs/vismath/radovic/index.html Antisymmetry and modularity in ornamental art]'', VisMath, '''3'''(2)</ref>
* Elementary constructions of Persian mosaics (2006)<ref>Sarhangi, R. and Jablan, S. (2006). ''Elementary constructions of Persian mosaics'', Math Horizons, '''14'''(1), 10-13, 39</ref>
* Knots and links in architecture (2012)<ref>Jablan, S., Radović, L. and Sazdanović, R. (2012). ''Knots and links in architecture'', Pollack Periodica, '''7'''(Suppl.), 65-76 {{doi| 10.1556/Pollack.7.2012.S.6}}</ref>
